complete_face_lattice.method: all 2^17 facet intersections, deduplicated by their nonempty sets of exact extreme rays; dimensions are 12 minus the exact rational rank of the common active pairing rows

conclusion.summary: The order-three divisor-wall fold is an exact finite-volume noncompact H12 Coxeter polytope. The order-six partitions are invalid for H12. No match occurs in the distributed CoxIter corpus, but global literature novelty remains open.

coxiter_repository.conclusion: No distributed CoxIter H12 diagram has 17 facets, so none is isomorphic to this diagram.

novelty_audit.warning: CoxIter's distributed examples are not an exhaustive classification of finite-volume H12 Coxeter polytopes. Absence there is evidence, not a proof of global novelty.

order_three_H12_fold.complete_inequality_argument: The source supplies all 21 nef inequalities. On a fixed class the three inequalities in either 3-cycle are equal and collapse to the orbit-sum inequality; the 15 singleton inequalities remain. The 17 orbits cover every source wall.
order_three_H12_fold.likely_abstract_lattice_identification: U + E8(-1) + A2(-1) + A1(-1) (rank/signature/determinant and displayed basis Gram agree; no uniqueness claim needed)

source.published_model: Double cover of P2 branched over an irreducible sextic of geometric genus 4 with an A11 singularity; the configuration includes the tangent line at the singularity, three bitangent lines through it, and a 6-tangent conic

surface_realization_boundary.role: Surface-automorphism realization is not a gate: the complete divisor-wall configuration plus its integral graph/lattice symmetry already defines the exact fixed-cone polytope.
surface_realization_boundary.status: not the published general-surface automorphism action; special-period Torelli realization is not needed or claimed

weighted_wall_graph_cyclic_census.order_six_conclusion: The order-six cyclic partitions have only nine orbits and fixed H6 signature; their orbit sums include one isotropic and one timelike vector, so they do not define the H12 fold.
